text.tspan: Since 15 June: 11 new accounts (8 standard, 3 net-price group, no guests), up 57 % on the
quarter before. Only 4 customers ordered, 2 of them more than once: 6 orders for
178,364.73 EUR, down 68 % against 557,096.36 EUR before. One account carries the period:
Dominique Aufderhar (10000), 2 orders, 173,215.24 EUR, 97 % of revenue. Jairo Johns (10001)
and Sandra Leffler (10008) follow with 2,703.73 and 1,542.89 EUR. Worth a look: revenue
